project.name: Linear inspiration review
project.description: Assess Linear's product patterns against Mission Control's existing capabilities. Prioritize refinements and selective additions without copying team-scale ceremony into a personal command center.

tasks.title: Define explainable Project Pulse
tasks.description: Evolve the existing computed project health into an explainable Pulse: lifecycle status remains separate; health shows on-track, watch, or off-track with reasons, freshness, trend, and suggested next action.

tasks.title: Wire project tags end to end
tasks.description: Mission Control already has project_tags storage and overview reads, but no project tag editing API/UI. Keep category as the primary grouping and add tags for cross-cutting themes, goals, contexts, and integrations.

tasks.title: Prototype portfolio roadmap timeline
tasks.description: Add a projects-only roadmap separate from the task due-date calendar. Reuse project phases, milestones, target dates, dependencies, categories, tags, and computed health; support zoom and grouping.

tasks.title: Add drillable scatter insight mode
tasks.description: Extend existing lead-time percentiles and task-age drilldowns with per-task scatter points, P50/P85/P95 bands, source/project segmentation, and click-to-open behavior.

tasks.title: Extend command palette scopes and actions
tasks.description: Build on the existing Ctrl+K hybrid search, quick-create parsing, slash search, and G-chords. Add explicit task/project/tag/source scopes and action commands; keep shortcuts discoverable in the palette.

tasks.title: Unify inbound triage semantics
tasks.description: Reconcile content triage, Scout actions, connector-created tasks, and notifications into a consistent accept, dismiss, snooze, merge, and route mental model without creating another inbox.

tasks.title: Prioritize integration platform capabilities
tasks.description: Favor MCP, inbound/outbound webhooks, n8n, custom REST, and connector capability contracts. Deepen a few high-value flows such as GitHub lifecycle, M365/Planner, browser capture, and actionable monitoring rather than cloning Linear's integration catalog.

tasks.title: Defer initiative entity pending evidence
tasks.description: Use category plus project tags and smart views as the initiative analog. Reconsider a first-class objective/initiative entity only when curated multi-project goals require ownership, target dates, resources, and rollup history.
